title: Pattern Dojo
description: Master the 18 algorithm patterns behind the NeetCode 150 — intuitively and interactively. NEWEST: The Interview Room, a timed, adaptive mock interview. It assembles a short problem set chosen to hunt your weakest patterns (a seeded PRNG weights each by its spaced-repetition mastery and your solve history, spread across patterns like a real loop), runs a countdown that auto-finishes at zero, judges your code in the same in-browser sandbox, and then grades not just whether you solved but HOW — speed against a difficulty-appropriate time budget, docked for every hint or peek — into a readiness score, a letter grade, personalised coach's notes, drill-these-next recommendations, and a from-scratch SVG readiness trend across sessions. Also includes a Complexity Profiler that measures the empirical Big-O of YOUR code (Theil–Sen log–log slope, from-scratch log–log chart) so an accepted-but-O(n²) answer gets flagged; Code Dojo, a from-scratch in-browser judge — solve curated problems in a real editor against sample + hidden tests in a sandboxed Web Worker (infinite loops caught as time-limits), every solve graduating that pattern into spaced review; plus 18 keyboard-driven step-through visualizers with shareable frame deep-links, a pattern-recognition trainer, a full SM-2 spaced-repetition engine with mastery tracking, a daily review dashboard, pattern-of-the-day, streaks, guided per-problem approaches, a printable complexity cheat-sheet, a ⌘K command palette, and a light/dark theme.
